mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees with overcast skies at the Military Ridge State Trail. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Contractors begin chip seal road maintenance on September 23. While roads remain open, expect traffic control in the Liberty Business Park and on East Verona Avenue. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development projects on October 5.
There is plenty to do with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival happening today, Bike the Barns today at Badger Prairie County Park, and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today.
In our weekly recap, on September 5, officers responded to reports of cheese slices found on vehicles throughout town, which was identified as a viral social media prank.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed today for a facility remodel.
